description: This file contains unit tests for the 'operator' package, specifically testing functionality related to polled device connection sets, including connection creation, retrieval, messaging, and destruction.

methods.name: TestNewPolledConnection
methods.description: Tests the creation of new polled device connections and ensures they have unique IDs and are created successfully.

methods.name: TestGetConnection
methods.description: Verifies that connections can be retrieved correctly by ID and are properly destroyed.

methods.name: TestMessages
methods.description: Checks that messages sent to a connection are stored and retrieved correctly, including message range.

methods.name: TestDestroy
methods.description: Tests the proper destruction of connections upon device disconnection.

methods.name: TestRandStr
methods.description: Validates the random string generation function for correct length and randomness.
